title: Cohere API key (unprefixed): one-property twin (context)
summary: 12 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: COHERE_API_KEY renamed COHERE_OWNER_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte, context: CO_API_KEY renamed CO_ORG_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and context: the Cohere model name replaced by an unrelated one, so no Cohere name remains in the block; the value is kept byte-for-byte, and 6 more. Twin of "Cohere API key (unprefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of cohere-api-key-compose-env: context: CO_API_KEY renamed CO_ORG_ID, an identifier name; the value is kept byte-for-byte. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
